overview: The Optiq is Cadillac's smallest and most affordable EV, an all-new compact luxury crossover for the 2025 model year. Five-passenger seating, 85-kWh Ultium battery, dual-motor AWD standard. Positioned as the entry to the Cadillac EV step-ladder. The 2026 model year introduces a single-motor RWD variant and the high-performance Optiq-V. The 2026 Optiq is Cadillac's first vehicle with a native NACS port. Sources: [Edmunds Optiq](https://www.edmunds.com/cadillac/optiq/), [Cadillac.com Optiq](https://www.cadillac.com/electric/optiq).
